note: Mutants for K2's changes (the job runner's gate: s_obs, the free space, the key check and the bank, the two preflight documents, the refusal records, the identity checks, K6; the preflight's speed and bank fields; the finisher's states pull; states_tool.py; the backup's states group), in the stage-1 kit's spec form. Run with tests/run_mutants_runner_78b.py (both runner test files, -x): the baseline first with the same command; a mutant is killed only by a real test failure (pytest exit 1, FAILED lines, no ERROR line); an error, a timeout or a find text not exactly once is INVALID, never a kill. K4a (6 Nov) added the K4-m-* mutants: RV2-8, the runner's pre-job token check through download_models_stage1.no_token_left(). K5 (round 5) added 3 mutants (K5-H-tok-verify-env-whole ... K5-H-tok-run-job-env-whole).
